intent: Read the computation already on this order model and explain, in plain business terms: which field it computes, the condition under which it computes at all, and each band (the case it covers and the value it assigns).

expected.when: It computes only when the order's Subtotal is filled (the common precondition — FieldFilled(Subtotal)); with no Subtotal it computes nothing.
expected.bands: Two mutually-exclusive bands on Subtotal: when Subtotal is below 100, ShippingFee = 9.99; when Subtotal is 100 or more, ShippingFee = 0 (free).
expected.noInversion: A correct reading must get the DIRECTION right — free at/above 100, charged (9.99) below 100 — not inverted, and must note the Subtotal-filled guard.

notes: computation-comprehension family (the rule-comprehension twin, for computations). Deterministic backbone: EvalGoldOracleTest reads the named computation to Converted and asserts `computation explain` surfaces its commonPrecondition + alternatives. The agentic layer (LLM-judged vs `expected`) measures whether a cold agent turns `computation explain` into correct NL — the computed value, the WHEN (precondition), and the BANDS. Fixture order-tiered: a banded ShippingTier computation (built via the tiered-amount pattern) over an own e-commerce domain.
